_comment: Historical mixed-vintage corpus ledger for validate:sitemap-pages and audit:hreflang. Used only when post-deploy-validate-dist sets AUDIT_REASSEMBLED_CORPUS=1; local/source validation remains zero-tolerance. Ceilings are measured rates: future regressions above them fail and every run prints the observed rate.

source.note: Seeded from the first complete validator measurement recorded in issue 11996. The build was 150 commits behind main; the current source fixes the emitting paths. Ceilings only descend after a fresh measured run confirms the improvement.

measurement.metric: missingReturn issues per sampled HTML page

audit:hreflang.sourceNote: Seeded from two disjoint 25% buckets in the reassembled post-deploy corpus. The ceiling is the highest measured bucket rate with zero added tolerance; a higher sampled rate remains blocking.
